headword: {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}
gloss: severance of diplomatic relations; breaking off diplomatic ties

definitions.gloss: severance of diplomatic relations; breaking off diplomatic ties
definitions.explanation: The formal act of ending official diplomatic relations between two countries, typically by recalling ambassadors, closing embassies, and ceasing government-level contact. Usually taken as a strong protest in response to serious incidents, acts of aggression, or deep policy disputes.

examples.japanese: {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}を{宣言|せんげん}する。
examples.english: To declare the severance of diplomatic relations.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうこく}は{長年|ながねん}{国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}の{状態|じょうたい}にある。
examples.english: The two countries have been in a state of severed diplomatic relations for many years.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}を{受|う}けて、{政府|せいふ}は{相手国|あいてこく}との{国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}も{辞|じ}さない{構|かま}えを{見|み}せた。
examples.english: In response to the incident, the government signaled that it was prepared even to sever diplomatic relations with the other country.

notes:
Composed of {国交|こっこう} (diplomatic relations, literally "country contact") and {断絶|だんぜつ} (severance, cutoff). Refers to one of the most serious measures a country can take short of war: formally ending all official diplomatic channels, usually by withdrawing ambassadors and closing embassies.

USAGE:
- Typically appears in political and news contexts rather than everyday conversation.
- Often paired with する to function verbally: {国交|こっこう}を{断絶|だんぜつ}する (to sever diplomatic relations).
- Contrasts with lesser measures such as recalling an ambassador for consultations, downgrading relations, or imposing sanctions — {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ} is the most severe diplomatic step.
- Citizens of the countries involved may lose consular protection after severance, so the term often appears alongside {在留邦人|ざいりゅうほうじん} (Japanese nationals abroad) in news reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}を{宣言|せんげん}する: to declare the severance of diplomatic relations
- {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}に{踏|ふ}み{切|き}る: to go ahead with severing diplomatic relations
- {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}も{辞|じ}さない: to be prepared even to sever ties
- {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}の{危機|きき}: a crisis of severed relations
- {国交断絶|こっこうだんぜつ}{状態|じょうたい}: a state of severed diplomatic relations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国交回復|こっこうかいふく}: restoration of diplomatic relations — the opposite action
- {国交樹立|こっこうじゅりつ}: establishing diplomatic relations — setting up ties for the first time
- {断交|だんこう}: severance of relations — a shorter, more formal synonym
- {経済制裁|けいざいせいさい}: economic sanctions — a less drastic alternative
- {大使|たいし}{召還|しょうかん}: recall of an ambassador — a step below full severance
